description: Delete a file, link or folder for real, like rm: there is no way back (use trash if you may want it back). A folder needs recursive: true (like rm -r), else FileBad. A link is deleted itself, not what it points to. Returns JSON {path, type, counter_files}. Errors: FileMissing, FileBad, PathBad (. or .. or /), RemoveFailed (for example no permission). Details: knowledge_read aos/tools/remove.json.

path.description: what to delete, relative to your workspace, or absolute

recursive.description: true = a folder is deleted with everything inside (like rm -r)
